headlines.summary: The EU-Canada trade deal has been provisionally in force since 2017, but ten EU countries have still not ratified it. What is CETA – and why, a decade after it was signed, is it still in limbo?

headlines.summary: The phenomenon sees retirees spend all their money on enjoying life to the full.

headlines.title: ECB launches 'Pontes' to settle tokenised assets in central bank money
headlines.summary: The Eurosystem has launched Pontes, a system allowing banks to settle trades in tokenised assets using central bank money, and the ECB said it will invest some of its own funds in tokenised securities through it, the first concrete steps towards making the euro fit for the digital age.

headlines.title: Germany faces energy tax losses as EV sales rise
headlines.summary: The rapid shift to electric vehicles in Germany is cutting fuel tax revenue for the government. As EV sales surge, policymakers face growing pressure to find new ways to fund roads and transportation infrastructure.

headlines.summary: New U.K. leader lands for the U.N. General Assembly — with one eye on voters who punished his globe-trotting predecessor back home.

headlines.summary: The deal includes an agreement to produce 30 films a year, or Paramount will be forced to sell off parts of its company.

headlines.title: Qatar rules out Hormuz pipeline bypass and reshapes its sovereign wealth strategy
headlines.summary: Qatar said a gas pipeline to bypass the Strait of Hormuz would make no economic sense. It also launched a new investment platform to manage QIA’s domestic holdings and outlined more than $60bn in investment opportunities, in a major reshaping of its sovereign wealth strategy.

headlines.title: Greek stock market joins world’s leading exchanges after debt crisis
headlines.summary: The Greek stock market joined FTSE Russell’s developed-market group on Monday, potentially attracting more international investment, while recent credit rating upgrades reflect the country’s improving public finances.

headlines.summary: Moscow isn’t seeking a full-scale war with NATO but instead trying to scare Europe into winding down its support for Ukraine, Finnish President tells POLITICO.

headlines.title: Flights at major US airports delayed after cable cut by construction workers
headlines.summary: The cable had been repaired and airports are resuming normal operations, the US transportation secretary says.

headlines.title: Volkswagen exits Euro Stoxx 50 as index removal adds to pressure on troubled firm
headlines.summary: Volkswagen has been removed from the Euro Stoxx 50, the eurozone's benchmark index of its largest listed companies, taking effect as markets opened on Monday just days after Europe's biggest carmaker warned that one-off charges would wipe out most of its profit this year.

headlines.summary: As the Middle East war disrupts global oil supplies and refining costs soar, diesel prices in France have reached record levels, making them among the highest in the EU.

trend_headline: 폭락과 지각변동: 유럽 자동차 산업의 구조적 위기 심화
summary: 폭스바겐이 유로 스톡스 50(Euro Stoxx 50) 지수에서 퇴출되고 볼보가 최고경영자를 전격 교체하는 등 유럽 자동차 섹터의 전례 없는 침체와 구조조정 압박이 가중되고 있습니다. 이와 동시에 프랑스의 디젤 가격 급등과 독일의 전기차 전환에 따른 유류세 세수 감소 우려가 겹치며 전통 에너지 및 모빌리티 인프라 전반에 걸쳐 정책적 전환점이 도래했습니다.
key_points: 폭스바겐(Volkswagen), 올해 수익 대부분을 잠식하는 일회성 비용 충당 경고 속 유로 스톡스 50 지수에서 퇴출
볼보(Volvo Cars), 실적 부진에 따른 턴어라운드를 위해 폭스바겐 스코다(Škoda)의 수장 클라우드 젤머를 새 CEO로 임명
프랑스 디젤 가격이 리터당 2.4유로를 돌파하며 중동발 공급 차질과 정유 비용 상승으로 유로존 에너지 비용 압박 심화
